blocks.text: JUNK REMOVAL FAQ
Commercial Junk Removal in Newmarket — Quick Questions, Full Answers

items.q: What does commercial junk removal cost in Newmarket?
a: Truck volume alone: small pickups from $125, larger loads scaling with the space they fill and nothing else. The exact figure is written free at your Newmarket business before anything moves — labour, dismantling and every disposal fee inside it — and it cannot change after approval.

items.q: Can the junk removal really happen without us closing?
a: That’s the design. We slot into your quietest window between 6AM and 11PM any day of the week, route everything through back and service doors, and keep the front of house untouched. Most clients’ customers only ever notice the extra space.

items.q: Do you clear medical and dental offices?
a: Yes — furniture, cabinetry, retired exam tables, reception fit-outs and office equipment all haul at standard volume rates, scheduled between appointments or after hours to protect patient flow. Biomedical and hazardous waste are the one exclusion; we’ll direct you to licensed specialty handlers for those.

items.q: How fast can a truck reach my Newmarket business?
a: Often the same day. Newmarket anchors our daily northern York routes, 6AM–11PM, seven days, so a morning call to +1 647 922 5865 regularly becomes an afternoon junk pickup — quoted as a real window, not a vague day.

items.q: Is a single-item junk pickup worth booking?
a: Always. One display case, one fridge, one retired photocopier — each prices as the sliver of truck space it uses, with no minimum fee inflating it. A steady share of our Newmarket stops are exactly this size.

items.q: What happens to everything after pickup?
a: A deliberate sort: donation partners take furniture and equipment with life left, licensed recyclers take metals, appliances and e-waste, and landfill receives only the remainder. Documentation of the breakdown is available whenever your records want it.

items.q: Can Newmarket landlords set up recurring junk removal?
a: Readily — plazas, business parks and mixed portfolios across town run on our standing schedules. Weekly, monthly or per-turnover, always at the same volume rates, consolidated to one invoice with one contact who knows every site.

items.q: Why are your rates 30–50% under the national junk removal brands?
a: No franchise royalty inside the quote — that’s the whole mechanism. The big names remit a share of every Newmarket job to head office; we’re local and independent, so the identical load simply invoices lower, visit after visit.
